description:
The monster has these weaknesses:

Forbiddance. The monster can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

Running Water. The monster takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

Stake to the Heart. The monster is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the monster's heart while the monster has the Incapacitated condition.

Sunlight. The monster takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
name: Vampire Weakness
